newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon bourse turnover up 21 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon bourse turnover up 21 pct in 1996.

text.p: Turnover on Lisbon bourse grew about 21 percent in 1996, compared with 1995, to stand at 3,370 billion escudos, the bourse said.

It said the total turnover included 1,800 billion escudos in public debt transactions and 1,030 billion escudos in share market deals as well as transactions in other instruments for which figures were not immediately available.
The PSI20 index of 20 leading shares rose by more than 30 percent year-on-year.
Turnover on Oporto Derivatives Exchange stood at 2,660 billion escudos since the launch of futures trade in June.
The 243,409 futures contracts traded on the exchange included 149,709 in 10-year Treasury bond futures, 82,510 in PSI20 futures and 11,190 in three-month Lisbor futures.
